title: Port IAM authentication to Java
description: Adds the Java IAM authentication token generator for ElastiCache, with tests, docs, and a TLS example, at parity with the Python package.

acceptance_criteria.text: Generates valid SigV4-signed IAM auth tokens for serverless caches and replication groups.
Validates inputs and reports errors without exposing credential material.

defects.summary: Sanitized error messages keep the provider exception as the cause, so logging the throwable exposes the raw credential detail.

label_notes: Unlabeled: unused exception classes, changelog layout, a missing session-token test assertion, and a CodeQL note on workflow permissions.
